create_student_whisper_model: create a distilled student Whisper model from a pre-trained teacher checkpoint with fewer layers
build_distilled_model_cli: build a student Whisper model from a teacher checkpoint using argparse CLI with encoder and decoder layer selection
test_model_forward_pass: test the converted student model with a forward pass to verify it loads and runs correctly
run_distillation_script: run the create_student_model script to initialize a smaller Whisper model from a teacher for distillation
review_init_student_model_from_teacher: review the init_student_model_from_teacher function that copies teacher weights and adjusts processor for student model
